}}'''Mair''' is an [[Arafel]]lin [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mair}}

== Appearance ==
She is plump with blue eyes.

== Activities ==
She tries to overwhelm [[Egwene al'Vere]] with commands when Egwene is on her way through the Accepted quarters. Egwene refuses to obey her.

She is attending [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] when the [[Seanchan]] attack. A Seanchan attack blows up part of Elaida's quarters and Elaida is captured in the raid. Mair reports this information to [[Saerin Asnobar]].
